issuing_authority: Department of Agriculture, Cooperation and Farmers' Welfare (DAC&FW), Ministry of Agriculture and Farmers' Welfare, Government of India
target_group: Landholding farmer families (husband, wife and minor children) who own cultivable land as per state land records

eligibility_rules.description: Owns cultivable land, and the name is entered in the state land records
No family member paid income tax in the last assessment year
No family member holds or has held a constitutional post, minister, MP, MLA, MLC, mayor or district panchayat chairperson
No family member is a serving or retired government, PSU, autonomous institution or regular local body employee (Class IV, Group D and multi-tasking staff excepted)
No retired pensioner receiving Rs 10,000 or more per month (Class IV, Group D and multi-tasking staff excepted)
No family member is a registered doctor, engineer, lawyer, chartered accountant or architect practising
Not an NRI (applies to new beneficiaries)
Ownership as of 01.02.2019 (inheritance by death is an exception)
eligibility_rules.note: Hard to self-check; state officials verify

benefits.component: Income support by DBT to the Aadhaar-seeded bank account
benefits.instalments: 3 instalments of Rs 2,000 every four months (April-July, August-November, December-March)

required_documents: Aadhaar number (needed for payment; exemptions for Assam, Meghalaya and J&K until 31.03.2021)
Bank account number and IFSC code, Aadhaar-seeded (essential portal attributes)
Land record details: survey or khata number and khasra number (optional on portal)
application_steps: Check whether your name is already on the beneficiary list at pmkisan.gov.in (search by name, Aadhaar or mobile) (para 9.6)
If your name is not found, ask the block, tehsil or taluka office to add you (paras 9.4(c), 9.6)
Make sure your Aadhaar is seeded to your bank account (para 10.3)
Sign a self-declaration of exclusions; the state certifies eligibility (para 4.2)
Lists are displayed at village level. Eligible farmers who were excluded can present their case (para 6.4)
deadline_note: The guideline sets no application deadline. Beneficiary lists are valid for one year and can be updated (para 11).
open_items: Confirm current portal registration steps; the guideline is from 2020 and the portal may have changed
